verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships visual tools like the Inspector (scene inspector/debugging and editing) and Node Material Editor (visual shader editor), plus Playground and Sandbox, but these are runtime-debugging/tweaking utilities layered on a fundamentally code-first engine, not a full level-building editor with viewport-driven prefab/scene composition workflows like a dedicated DCC or game-engine editor. missing for 10: a documented prefab/instance system, a scene-composition-as-primary-workflow editor (not just debugging), and evidence that technical artists build levels without code.
